title: BT31009: Genetics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Mendelian inheritance, physical basis of inheritance, gene interaction,
multiple alleles, complementation, linkage, recombination and chromosome
mapping, extrachromosal inheritance, sex determination, special types of
chromosomes. Chromosomal variations: numerical - euploidy and aneuploidy;
structural - deletion, duplication, inversion and translocation. Genes at the
population level. Bacterial and viral genetic systems: genomes of E.coli,
lambda, and other DNA and RNA viruses. Molecular mechanisms of recombination;
mutagenesis; and transposable elements. Molecular basis of genetic diseases and
genetic counseling. Application of molecular genetic techniques.
